name: Wearable AI Assistants & Augmented Reality
summary: AI that sees and hears from the wearer's point of view and overlays information on the world, as in smart glasses, heads-up displays and AR headsets.

topics.name: AR and MR fundamentals: optical versus video see-through, heads-up displays
Head tracking and visual-inertial odometry on headsets
Spatial mapping and scene understanding for AR
Egocentric vision: activity recognition and episodic memory (Ego4D)
Multimodal assistant pipelines: voice plus vision
On-device models under power, thermal and latency budgets
Information display and attention management on HUDs
Case studies: smart glasses, pilot and soldier HUDs
